title: BlueJS application configuration
description: Editor schema for the BlueJS config-file convention: ./config/application.json and ./config/application-{profile}.json (TOON variants decode to the same JSON model). PERMISSIVE BY DESIGN — application keys are unconstrained (additionalProperties: true); this schema documents only the framework namespaces and never rejects an unknown key. Profile files are structurally identical to the base file.

server.title: HTTP server
server.description: Managed HTTP server settings (platform-node HTTPServer). Extra keys are preserved as config values.

name.description: Application/server name. Bound by an app's @configurationProperties('server') class (default 'blue-api' in the bundled example); the framework itself does not read it.

port.description: TCP port to listen on. Defaults to the PORT environment variable, then 3000. 0 requests an ephemeral port. An out-of-range value fails server construction.

host.description: Host/interface to bind to (platform-node HTTPServer default is 127.0.0.1).

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Profile activation, mirroring the CLI/env channels (AD-14): CLI --profiles.* > BLUE_PROFILES_* env > builder .profiles(). Extra keys are preserved as config values.

active.description: Profiles to activate. Highest-precedence activation channel is the CLI (--profiles.active=prod) over env BLUE_PROFILES_ACTIVE; the last source wins.

default.description: Fallback profiles consulted only when nothing is explicitly active (--profiles.default / BLUE_PROFILES_DEFAULT).

group.description: Profile group names expanded to their member profiles (--profiles.group.<name> / BLUE_PROFILES_GROUPS, 'name=m1,m2;other=…').

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.description: OpenTelemetry knobs mirrored from TelemetryConfig (@blue/telemetry-node), the object accepted by configureTelemetry(). Extra keys are preserved as config values.

sampler.description: Root-span sampling: 'always' (default, 100%), 'off', or { ratio: number } in [0, 1]. Ratios outside the range or NaN fail loud at configuration time. Child spans inherit the root decision.

traceExporter.description: Trace export. undefined/'console'/{ console: true } selects the console exporter (dev default); 'none' disables the signal; { url, headers? } selects OTLP/HTTP. OTLP urls are validated at configuration time.

metricExporter.description: Metric export — same exporter spec as traceExporter.

logExporter.description: Log export — same exporter spec as traceExporter. Configuring anything but 'none' also routes LoggerFactory through the OpenTelemetry logger.

management.title: Management endpoints
management.description: Management endpoint settings (/health, /metrics — ManagementAutoConfiguration). The endpoints are open by default; extra keys are preserved as config values.

redactHealthErrors.description: Whether thrown health-indicator errors are redacted on /health (default true): the status stays DOWN and the component name is preserved, but the exception text is replaced so indicator internals never reach the wire.

configValue.title: Config value
configValue.description: Any JSON value. A plain object carrying a `cipher` key is the {cipher:…} at-rest secret marker: a MARKER interpreted by the secret resolver at lookup time (with BLUE_SECRET_KEY wired), not an ordinary object value — the ciphertext lives in the file, the key in a separate channel. With no decryptor wired, the marker passes through as raw text.

cipher.description: {cipher:…} secret marker, e.g. 'v1:<base64 ciphertext>'. The scheme segment dispatches the decryptor.

samplerSpec.title: Sampler spec
samplerSpec.description: Trace sampling configuration (SamplerSpec): a preset or a ratio object.

ratio.description: Fraction of root spans kept, in [0, 1].

url.description: OTLP/HTTP endpoint; validated at configuration time. Omit for the default endpoint.

headers.description: Headers forwarded on export (e.g. bearer auth); never logged.

console.description: Explicitly select the console exporter (equiv. to 'console').
